title: Clifton Cultural Arts Center (CCAC)

services.name: The Golden Ticket
services.desc: CCAC’s annual Golden Ticket Juried Art exhibition, presented by Summerfair Cincinnati, showcases diverse, talented artists living or working within a 50-mile radius of the Clifton Cultural Arts Center. Over $2,000 in prizes will be awarded for Best in Show (for whom CCAC will also host a solo exhibition), second and third place, and honorable mention. We’re also offering a brand new award to outstanding works in the installation art category. We’re introducing a new $500 Installation Award to celebrate ambitious, site-responsive work that engages the architecture of CCAC in unexpected ways. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: CCAC has a huge selection of week-long arts camps for this summer to get your child out of the house and flexing their creative muscles. During our multi-disciplinary elementary camps, your little one will become a super hero, spy, princes, or knight, in a week packed with a variety of artistic activities from drawing, acting, writing, and so much more. In “My First Summer Camp,” preschoolers will take part in hands-on projects, playful outdoor moments, and cozy rest times-at a pace perfectly suited for their first camp experience. And in our all new teen camps, older artists will get the chance to take a deep dive in a specific craft of their intrest like digital art or fashion design.

services.name: Team Building
services.desc: Whether you’re looking for a convenient and central meeting location, a fresh off-site team-building activity, or a unique and inspiring setting to host staff and clients, CCAC’s accessible building is the place to do it. Speak with our professional event staff today to begin putting together a package - totally customized to your needs. For fifteen years, CCAC has excelled at bringing diverse people together through the shared experience of art. Let us use our knowledge to help grow your team’s cohesion and creativity.
